title: Address organisation identity across facility, workforce and supplier registries
requirements:
- Assess whether a shared organisation registry or identifier capability is needed, or where it comes from
- Assess whether an Organisation Registry is needed or another source applies
- Distinguish organisations (provider groups, payers, laboratories, regulators) from facilities and individual workers
- Show how organisations, locations, practitioners, roles and services are distributed across components, consistent with mCSD
- Reframe the three supply-chain pillars as non-exhaustive master-data domains
- Clarify boundaries of business-service components such as decision support and surveillance delivery
- Apply one organisation-identifier model across registries
